The R360 million SAPS Medicare24 tender corruption case involving National Police Commissioner Fannie Masemola, controversial businessman Vusimuzi Cat Matlala and other senior police officers has been postponed to 26 June 2026 at the Pretoria Magistrate’s Court, while Matlala remains in custody at Kgosi Mampuru Prison. | MDN News
